known_gaps: The expanded all-backend Ruff scope has pre-existing lint and formatting debt; CI currently enforces a gradual subset.
PostgreSQL RLS is deferred until per-request database connection identity and an isolation test strategy exist.
JSON compatibility storage supports Default Scope only and is not a multi-tenant isolation boundary.
Member phone compatibility data remains until uuid_only production evidence supports a separate forward contract migration.
Payment provider integration is not implemented; payment_pending and paid are state contracts only.
Pilot SLO values are targets, not measured attainment, and the repository is not declared Production Certified.
API v1 write contracts remain on legacy compatibility routes until each caller and idempotency boundary migrates.
Frontend visual regression has no approved screenshot baseline; visual comparison remains inconclusive.
Legacy Kiosk WebSocket token-in-query compatibility remains until device-session callers are fully migrated.
Default outbox delivery sink is in-process success marker; external analytics/POS consumers remain future milestones.
Specialized RAG rebuild/report/AI job handlers are registered contracts; provider-specific adapters expand in Phase 3+.
Staging-like docker compose image build was not executed in this environment (Docker unavailable).
Isolated restore drill execute mode remains an operations exercise against a real backup target.
